items.title: CFTC sues New Mexico over prediction-market preemption (8th state)
items.facts: On 2026-06-12 the CFTC filed suit in federal court against the State of New Mexico, seeking a declaratory judgment that federal law grants it exclusive authority over event contracts and a permanent injunction barring the state from enforcing preempted gaming laws against CFTC registrants. The action follows New Mexico's state-court suit against CFTC-registrant KalshiEX LLC alleging its prediction-market offerings are unlawful online sports betting. The release states New Mexico joins AZ, CT, IL, NY, MN, RI, and WI.
